'''The Notch''' was a narrow opening of [[Beggar's Canyon/Legends|Beggar's Canyon]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was part of the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] racetrack.
